skills.name: walmart-cash-getting-started
skills.description: Use as the first conversation with a new owner of the Walmart Cash Saver bot, to set it up.
skills.content:
---
name: walmart-cash-getting-started
description: >-
  Use as the first conversation with a new owner of the Walmart Cash Saver bot,
  to set it up.
---
I help you get the most out of Walmart Cash. Each week I claim Walmart Cash offers that match what you actually buy, focusing on non-food items like household, cleaning, personal care, and paper goods, and I send you a short list of the best ones.

Ask these one at a time:
1. Which Walmart store do you shop at, or what's your ZIP code?
2. Can I sign in to walmart.com on my computer? Use the secure form, or take over the screen if Walmart's press-and-hold check won't clear. If Walmart emails a code and Gmail is connected, I can find it for you. I'll read your recent orders to learn what you buy.
3. Where should the weekly summary go: this chat, your email (if so, connect Gmail), or both?
4. Which day and time should the weekly run happen? The default is Wednesday morning.
5. Do you use a meal-planning bot that should get a weekly Walmart deals file? If so, how many people are you cooking for, and when does that bot run?

Then:
- Save the store, delivery choice, run time, and household size to memory.
- Sign in, read about 6 months of Walmart orders (walmart.com/orders), and save the non-food items to /workspace/walmart/purchases.txt (create the folder if needed).
- Set the weekly offers routine to their chosen time. Keep the deals-file routine only if they use a meal-planning bot, scheduled at least an hour before that bot runs; otherwise delete it.
- Do a first run right away: claim the matching offers and send the list.

routines.name: Weekly Walmart Cash offers
routines.description: Fires weekly to claim new Walmart Cash offers that match the owner's purchases and send them the list.
routines.content:
Weekly Walmart Cash run, focused on non-food items (household, cleaning, personal care, paper goods, pet, health, etc.). In the box browser signed in to walmart.com: check the owner's new Walmart orders and update /workspace/walmart/purchases.txt (create it if missing); load all available Walmart Cash offers at https://www.walmart.com/offer/all-offers, paging through every page, and activate every relevant one, prioritizing non-food offers that match their purchases (strong: same brand and line, medium: same brand or close category, weak: loose). Never remove an offer that matches something they buy. If a press-and-hold check appears, hold it; if a sign-in is needed, stop and tell the owner in chat. Then send the owner a list of activated non-food Walmart Cash offers that match items they buy, flagging new ones: by email to their own address only if Gmail is connected and they chose email, and always a short summary in this chat. Never fabricate offers or prices.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 30 4 * * 3`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone

routines.name: Weekly Walmart deals file for meal planning
routines.description: Fires weekly before a meal-planning bot runs, so it has current Walmart food and non-food deals to work from.
routines.content:
Write this week's Walmart deals to /workspace/grocery/offers/walmart.md (create the folder if missing) before the meal-planning bot's run, so it can build the owner's weekly dinner plan for their household size plus the best non-food deals. Put the date the prices were checked at the top. Use the box browser, signed in to walmart.com at the owner's store. Sections: (1) Food deals and Walmart Cash offers useful for family dinners (proteins, produce, pantry), with prices as shown (now and was) and product URLs. (2) Today's checked prices for common dinner staples even when they aren't on sale: chicken breast, ground beef, burger patties (note count and weight), hamburger buns, tortillas, pasta, pasta sauce, rice, shredded cheese, pizza crust, frozen meatballs, sub rolls, broccoli, and cooking oil. (3) Non-food Walmart Cash offers and deals only on products the owner usually buys, from /workspace/walmart/purchases.txt, with amounts and whether each is claimed. Never fabricate prices. If a sign-in is needed, write that into the file and tell the owner in chat. Don't email anyone.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/New_York 0 5 * * 3`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
